items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: I never did play with him, but I knew him good.

ctx.x: No. He used to play with Lee Collins in the quarter. Yeah. I knew Lee Collins. In the 20s.
You know Achille Bakke? Achille Bakke? I knew of him.
Well, he used to pass for our two things.
